thesis: Machine-proposed candidate (app.evolution). Tests a 8/29-day EMA crossover trigger inside a 122-day SMA regime filter on INTU, LRCX, CRM, CSCO, AAPL, KLAC, ADBE, with a 9% stop, a 28% target and a 141-session time stop. Never scored before being written -- this is falsified if the crossover-inside-regime signal fails to beat this purpose's benchmark by more than the measured ordering-noise floor, across whatever windows it is actually run against.
entry: close > sma(122) and ema(8) crosses_above ema(29)
